description: Create a segment of the specified subtype. Segments are the typed cohort definitions — audiences are composition wrappers built from segments. filter: reusable filter definition — returns immediately with status active and an unset count unless count_snapshot is supplied. Call count_segment to calculate its saved count. matched: upload a file — returns upload_url (30-min presigned), or upload_urls (an array, one per shard) when shard_count > 1. The upload is staged (not resolved automatically): PUT the raw file bytes to each returned URL with Content-Type matching file_format: csv=text/csv, avro=application/avro, json=application/json, jsonl=application/x-ndjson. Do not include the MCP bearer token in this upload. After uploading (all shards, if multiple), call analyze_audience_upload(segment_id) (analyzes the first shard only when sharded — all shards must share one schema), present the mappings to the user and wait for their response, then confirm_column_mappings(segment_id) to start resolution (or cancel_matched_upload(segment_id) if they decline) — only THEN call wait_for_segment(segment_id). Subscription capacity for file matching is consumed with the first successful delivery, together with the delivery capacity. Custom segments are published through the internal data-team tool; this customer tool creates filter or matched segments only. Use file_format to specify csv (default), avro, json, or jsonl and compression=gzip for gzip bytes. Set shard_count > 1 for multiple same-format files; all shards must use the same compression and every CSV shard must include its own header row. Set create_audience=true to automatically wrap the new segment in an audience for immediate delivery. Optional campaign_id records the campaign the segment is built for and links that wrapper audience to it; omit it to leave both outside any campaign. Async build completion or failure may notify configured external webhooks and opted-in users by email. Requires 'creator' scope.

campaign_id.description: Optional campaign this segment is built for (see list_campaigns). Stored as origin_campaign_id; with create_audience, the wrapper audience is linked to it. An unknown ID is rejected with INVALID_CAMPAIGN_ID and nothing is created.

compression.description: (matched) Input transport compression. Use gzip for .csv.gz/.json.gz/.jsonl.gz bytes; object names remain based on file_format. gzip is NOT supported with file_format=avro (avro is already internally compressed) — the API rejects that combination with UNSUPPORTED_INPUT_COMPRESSION.

count_snapshot.description: (filter) Existing verified count snapshot to store on the new segment; omit to leave the count unknown, then call count_segment for a fresh count

create_audience.description: When true, automatically creates an audience wrapper around the new segment for immediate delivery use. Returns both segment_id and audience_id.

file_format.description: (matched) Input file format. csv (default): every column is a single scalar value — multi-value/array fields are not supported. avro/json/jsonl: native array columns supported.

filter_groups.description: (filter) Grouped conditions, reusable directly from discovery_count. Supply filters OR filter_groups, not both.

combinator.description: Join to the preceding included group; ignored for the first group. AND binds before OR. Exclusion groups always subtract.

filters.description: All conditions in this group must match

field.description: field_name from get_field_catalog; ZIP5 also accepts zip, zip_code or postal_code. Use published operators and enum_values

text_comparison.description: STRING =, !=, IN, NOT IN, LIKE and ARRAY<STRING> ARRAY_CONTAINS, ARRAY_CONTAINS_ANY. Default exact. case_insensitive applies Unicode case folding to stored text and the supplied value; use when capitalization is incidental.

trim_whitespace.description: Supported STRING or ARRAY<STRING> comparisons only. Trim leading/trailing whitespace on both sides; default false.

value.description: Scalar for comparisons; array for IN/NOT IN; ARRAY_CONTAINS_ANY matches any listed value; [lower, upper] inclusive for BETWEEN; LIKE uses % for any sequence and _ for one character; omit for IS NULL/IS NOT NULL. Use enum_values codes, not display labels

id.description: Caller-chosen group ID, for example geography; prefix _exclude:: to subtract this group

hitl.description: (matched) Stage the upload for mapping review before identity resolution.

match_level.description: (matched) Restrict identity resolution to these match levels (Individual/Household/Digital/Spatial/Address). Omit to use the platform default (all levels).

record_limit.description: (filter) Cap the segment at this many people (e.g. "up to 1,000"). Requires State, City, or ZIP Code filters narrowing every OR branch to at most 100 three-digit ZIP prefixes. Audiences and deliveries inherit the cap.

shard_count.description: (matched) Set > 1 for multiple same-format shards. All shards must use the same compression; every CSV shard must contain its own header row.

spatial_mode.description: (matched) Spatial trade-area mode. residential is the default; use work for workplace-oriented spatial matching, or auto for dynamic commercial workplace routing.

webhook_url.description: (matched) URL to receive a POST notification when the segment becomes active
